content.title: Heartland Express (HTLD): Losses Accelerate 44% Annually, Challenging Value Narrative Despite Low Valuation
content.summary: Heartland Express (HTLD) remains unprofitable, with losses rising at an annualized rate of 44% over the last five years, and net profit margin showing no sign of improvement. Revenue is forecast to grow by 5.2% per year, which lags behind the broader US market average of 10.3%. Despite this muted growth, investors may find some reward in the company's discounted trading price, as its Price-to-Sales Ratio of 0.6x sits well below the US Transportation industry average of 1.3x.
